intro: The Arbor table is a centrepiece of style and convenience. With smart storage, a rich walnut finish, and lasting durability, it balances elegance and function for your everyday needs.

features.title: Keep essentials close and organised
features.text: Why choose between storage and style? Keep your books, gadgets, or décor neatly organised while adding a modern touch to your space.

features.title: Hidden drawer keeps essentials close
features.text: Our discreet drawer blends seamlessly into your furniture, keeping remotes, stationery, and all your daily essentials neatly stored but always close at hand.

features.title: Scratch-resistant for worry-free use
features.text: Crafted from high-quality engineered wood, our furniture withstands everyday use while its protective laminate keeps it looking flawless.

features.title: Spacious table top with added ledge for ease
features.text: Keep your space tidy with a table top that’s perfect for books and display—because organisation should be easy.

features.title: Walnut finish adds timeless warmth
features.text: The Remini Walnut shade adds warmth and sophistication, making your interiors feel instantly more inviting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
